production.format_and_medium.summary: Copies provided may include the transmission of electronic copies of public records.

production.delivery_and_completion.summary: For non-state-agency public records, the custodian has a duty to provide copies to a requester, unless the requester fails to pay applicable copying fees after advance notice of the amount or has an outstanding balance from a prior request.

production.inspection_access.summary: If the requested record is immediately available (not in active use), it shall be immediately presented to the requester.
production.inspection_access.clock_spec: undefined-soft: "immediately" from application (when record not in active use)

production.inspection_access.summary: If the record is in active use, the custodian shall promptly certify this in writing and fix a day and hour within three days (excluding weekends and legal holidays) for the requester to exercise the right.
production.inspection_access.clock_spec: ceiling: within 3 business-days from application (excl. Sat/Sun/legal holidays)

eligibility.incarcerated_requester_exclu.summary: An individual in custody after sentence following a felony conviction who has exhausted appellate remedies is not a 'person' entitled to records unless the request is limited to grounds for post-conviction relief under C.Cr.P. art. 930.3.

intake.identity_requirement.summary: The custodian may inquire as to the requester's age and identification and may require the requester to sign a register.

eligibility.any_person.summary: Any person of the age of majority may inspect, copy, or reproduce any public record, except as otherwise provided by this Chapter or specifically provided by law.

eligibility.no_purpose_requirement.summary: The custodian shall make no inquiry of a requester except as to age and identification; no statement of purpose may be required.

eligibility.no_residency_requirement.summary: Access is available to any person of the age of majority; no Louisiana residency is required to inspect, copy, or reproduce a public record.

eligibility.no_age_requirement.summary: Any person (no age-of-majority limit) may obtain a copy or reproduction of any public record.

fee.waiver.summary: Copies of records may be furnished without charge or at a reduced charge to indigent citizens of the state.

custody.referral_to_proper_custodian.summary: If the requested record is not in the custody/control of the person applied to, that person shall promptly certify in writing the reason for its absence, its location, who has custody, and how/when it left his custody.

Clarification.deny.label: Deny as vague / overbroad
Clarification.deny.note: Deny-as-vague is narrower than reasonably-describes membership: TN·NJ·OH, OK only after SB 535 engagement (diagram legend, v2.2).

fee.waiver.summary: Copies of records may be furnished without charge or at a reduced charge to indigent citizens of the state.

Estimate-Fee.proc.label: No → proceed to work; collect at end
Estimate-Fee.proc.note: Collect-at-end is the default path wherever production is NOT statutorily conditioned on prepayment.

Records-Search.prog.label: BUT extraction/programming of EXISTING
Records-Search.prog.note: Programming-≠-creation loop is TX 552.231 only; the broader no-duty-to-create concept (16 states) is context, not an activator.

special_records.special_production_const.summary: If the custodian reasonably determines a request would substantially disrupt required government operations, the custodian may deny access, but only after reasonable attempts to narrow or specify the request with the requester.

Disposition.caps.label: REQUESTOR-LEDGER CHECK (class D)
Disposition.caps.note: Requestor-ledger class-D delivery caps (OH) ride on ledger config; see ledger section.

acknowledgment.note: No statutory timer — city operational target only (soft-standard pattern S-002).

response.initial_decision_window.summary: When the custodian raises a question whether an item is a public record, the custodian shall, within five days (excluding weekends and legal holidays) of receipt of the request, notify the requester in writing of the determination and the reasons.
response.initial_decision_window.clock_spec: ceiling: within 5 business-days from receipt of the written request (excl. Sat/Sun/legal holidays)

denial.deemed_denial_on_nonresponse.summary: Passage of five days (excluding weekends and legal holidays) from an in-person, written, or electronic request without receiving a written determination or a time estimate constitutes a denial, entitling the requester to enforcement proceedings.
denial.deemed_denial_on_nonresponse.clock_spec: terminal: 5 business-days from request (in-person/written/electronic), excl. Sat/Sun/legal holidays, with no determination or estimate

fee.copy_rate_per_page.summary: The custodian may establish and collect reasonable fees for making copies of public records.

fee.labor_charge.summary: When examination is conducted outside regular working hours, persons representing the custodian are entitled to reasonable compensation, paid by the public body and funded in advance by the party demanding the extraordinary examination.

fee.no_charge_categories.summary: No fee may be charged to examine or review a public record, or to determine whether a record is subject to disclosure, except as provided in this Section.

fee.schedule_and_authority.summary: A custodian who elects to collect copying fees shall establish a reasonable fee schedule and post it where it can be readily accessed by the public.
For state-agency public records, copy fees shall be charged according to the uniform fee schedule adopted by the commissioner of administration (R.S. 39:241) or as otherwise fixed by law.

custody.custodian_definition_and_role.summary: The 'custodian' who must respond is the public official or head of the public body having custody or control of the record, or a representative specifically authorized by him to respond to inspection requests.
Providing access to public records is a mandatory responsibility and duty of the custodian's office and its employees.

fee.schedule_and_authority.summary: A custodian who elects to collect copying fees shall establish a reasonable fee schedule and post it where it can be readily accessed by the public.
For state-agency public records, copy fees shall be charged according to the uniform fee schedule adopted by the commissioner of administration (R.S. 39:241) or as otherwise fixed by law.
